lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We are from the Missilis Research Team.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Yes, everything's fine.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We've developed a support robot.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: A new VOLT model, VOLT-JU052.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We refer to it simply as Volt Jr.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Unfortunately, it's gone missing.
Is it similar to the one that Liter has?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: If you're referring to the Nikke belonging to Missilis Industries,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: negative.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: That Nikke owns a VOLT-N00 model,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: of which very few remain.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: The one that ran away is a newer version which is fully autonomous

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: and capable of various technical feats.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: In contrast, the older models are not capable of having their own agency.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Therefore, there is a stark difference between the two models.
Got it.
But aren't they part of the same series?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: This conversation

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: has gone on long enough.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Forgive my bluntness,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: but I will now proceed to the mission briefing.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I want you to locate the missing Volt robot.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: The last signal we picked up placed it near the tundra up north.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: If at all possible, capture it intact.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: If, however, you find that to be impossible,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: you may do what has to be done.
You mean destroy it?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: It will be necessary in order to safeguard Missilis industry's technology

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: and prevent it from falling into the wrong hands.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: If you have any misgivings, please inform me as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I will see if other Commanders can handle the assignment.
Mission accepted.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Excellent.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I will assign you as the Commanding Officer for this assignment

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: and send you the coordinates now.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: It was nice meeting you.
